title: A prayer in this mosque of mine is better than a thousand prayers anywhere else, except for the Sacred Mosque
hadeeth: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said: "A prayer in this mosque of mine is better than a thousand prayers anywhere else, except for the Sacred Mosque."
explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) pointed out the merit of prayer in his Mosque and that it brings a greater reward than a thousand prayers offered in any other mosque in the world, except for the Sacred Mosque in Makkah, where prayer is better than prayer in his Mosque (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him).
hints: The reward for the prayer offered in the Sacred Mosque and the Prophet's Mosque is multiplied.
Prayer in the Sacred Mosque is better than a hundred thousand prayers offered in other mosques.
hadeeth_intro: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said:
hadeeth_ar: عَنْ ‌أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: «صَلَاةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِي هَذَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ صَلَاةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ إِلَّا الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ».
hadeeth_intro_ar: عَنْ ‌أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ:
explanation_ar: بَيَّنَ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فضْلَ الصلاةِ في مسجده، وأنه أفضل ثوابًا من ألف صلاة فيما سواه من مساجد الأرض، إلا المسجد الحرام بمكة، فهي أفضل من الصلاة في مسجده صلى الله عليه وسلم.
hints_ar: مُضاعَفة أجر الصلاة في المسجد الحرام، والمسجد النبوي.
الصلاةَ في المسجد الحرام خيرٌ مِن مائة ألفِ صلاةٍ في غيره مِن المساجد.
